title_en: Regulation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Treating Illegal Planting of Opium Poppy Constituting a Crime as the Crime of Manufacturing Drugs
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court  Supreme People's Procuratorate

Provisions on Punishing Illegal Planting of Opium Poppies Constituting a Crime as the Crime of Drug Manufacturing

Fa (Yan) Fa [1990] No. 14

In order to eliminate the source of raw materials for drug manufacturing and to lawfully punish the criminal act of illegally planting opium poppies, the following provisions are hereby made:

1. Whoever illegally plants 500 or more but fewer than 3,000 opium poppies shall be punished as the crime of drug manufacturing in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph 1 of Article 171 of the Criminal Law; whoever illegally plants 3,000 or more opium poppies shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph 2 of Article 171 of the Criminal Law.

2. Whoever illegally plants 500 or more opium poppies and voluntarily uproots and destroys them before the sap is collected may be given a mitigated punishment or exempted from punishment.

3. These Provisions shall come into force as of the date of promulgation. Cases pending handling after the date of promulgation shall be governed by these Provisions.

July 9, 1990
